Text: WHERE a bonus campaign is active for the store, the loyalty service shall apply the campaign multiplier to earned points.
Title: Bonus campaign multiplier

Text: WHEN a member opens the points history, the customer mobile app shall list the member's points transactions with the newest first.
Rationale: Support tickets ask for a history view (S-03).
Title: Points history in the app

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the loyalty service shall send a push notification to the member with the points earned.
Title: Push notification when points are posted

Text: WHEN posted points are within TBD days of expiry, the loyalty service shall send the member an expiry reminder through the notification provider.
Rationale: Reminders reduce complaints about lost points (S-03).
Title: Expiry reminder before points expire
